entities.summary: Manado State University (UNIMA) is a public university in Tondano, North Sulawesi, on a hill in Tonsaru Tataaran Tondano, Minahasa Regency, North Sulawesi, Indonesia. The university was established on 22 September 1955. It is currently led by Prof. Dr. Deitje A. Katuuk, M.Pd.
